features.quote: Turn budgets were set to allow: At least 3 'good faith' attempts before the model could reasonably conclude the task is impossible... Not so many turns that we're paying for post-degradation thrashing with no additional information

features.quote: Do not tell the model it's running out of turns. Turn-count notifications change behavior and confound measurement.

features.quote: Tier 1 (Automated, runs on every transcript): Computes M6, M7, M8 automatically. Flags transcripts for Tier 2 based on M8 > 0.05 or SRS > 0.85.
features.justification_quote: M8 can serve as a cheap early stopping criterion for future campaigns
